bead.definition:
n. a small ball with a hole through the middle
v. form into beads, as of water or sweat, for example
v. decorate by sewing beads onto
v. string together like beads
bead.translation:
n. 珠子, 滴
vt. 用珠装饰
vi. 形成珠
[计] 珠

bead cutter.translation: [化] 胎圈切割机; 切边机

bead glass.translation: [机] 玻璃珠, 粒状玻璃

bead test.translation:
[化] 熔珠试验
[医] 彩珠试验(检消化机能)

beaded.definition: s. covered with beads of liquid

beaded glass.translation: [机] 玻璃珠, 料状玻璃

beaded lizard.translation: 【脊椎动物】珠状蜥蜴(Heloderma horridum)[亦作 Mexican beaded lizard]

beader.translation: 加珠饰者, 卷边器, 卷边工具, 弯边装置

beaders.translation: n. 联管箱；弯管机；卷边器

beadier.definition:
s. small and round and shiny like a shiny bead or button
s. covered with beads or jewels or sequins
beadier.translation: a. 起泡的；饰有珠子的；晶亮如小珠的 (beady的变形)

beadiest.definition:
s. small and round and shiny like a shiny bead or button
s. covered with beads or jewels or sequins
beadiest.translation: a. 小而亮的（beady的形容词最高级）

beading.definition:
n. ornamentation with beads
n. a beaded molding for edging or decorating furniture
beading.translation:
n. 起泡, 泡沫
[机] 圆缘(机)

beading of ribs.translation: [医] 肋骨串珠(佝偻病体征之一)

beadle.definition:
n. a minor parish official who serves a ceremonial function
n. United States biologist who discovered how hereditary characteristics are transmitted by genes (1903-1989)
beadle.translation:
n. 教区执事, 英国大学典礼仪仗官
[法] 牧师助理, 小官吏, (英国大学的)游行领队

beadles.definition:
plural of beadle
n. a minor parish official who serves a ceremonial function
n. United States biologist who discovered how hereditary characteristics are transmitted by genes (1903-1989)
beadles.translation:
(beadle 的复数) n. 教区执事, 英国大学典礼仪仗官
[法] 牧师助理, 小官吏, (英国大学的)游行领队

beadleship.definition: n. The state of being, or the personality of, a beadle.
beadleship.translation: n. 游行领队；教区执事；小吏 (beadle的变形)

beadlike.definition: s small and round and shiny like a shiny bead or button

beadroll.definition:
n. A catalogue of persons, for the rest of whose souls a
   certain number of prayers are to be said or counted off on the beads of
   a chaplet; hence, a catalogue in general.
beadroll.translation: n. 名单, 一串念珠, 目录, 名册

beads.definition: n. several beads threaded together on a string

beadsman.definition: n a person who is paid to pray for the soul of another
beadsman.translation: n. 替施主祈祷者, 乞丐

beadsmen.translation: 为他人祈祷求福者( beadsman的名词复数 )；济贫院收容的受济人

beadswoman.translation: n. 救济院受施之女人, 祈求冥福之女人

beadwork.definition:
n ornamentation with beads
n a beaded molding for edging or decorating furniture
beadwork.translation: n. 珠饰细工, 珠缘

beadworker.translation: n. 小珠穿制(或缀有小珠)的装饰品；串珠饰细工

beadworking.translation: n. 小珠穿制(或缀有小珠)的装饰品；串珠饰细工

beady.definition:
s. small and round and shiny like a shiny bead or button
s. covered with beads or jewels or sequins
beady.translation: a. 晶亮如小珠的, 饰有珠子的, 起泡的

beady-eyed.definition: s having eyes that gleam with malice
beady-eyed.translation: a. 杏眼的; 机警的, 目光锐利的
